items.name: Heliuspace
items.description: HeliuSpace is shortening lengthy space launch turnaround times by introducing a modular and re-usable rocket engine with single-stage-to-orbit capabilities. Allowing launch service providers to refurbish their launch vehicles faster between launches so that they may rapidly launch more of their customers’ satellites.
